headword: {快気内祝|かいきうちいわ}い
gloss: thank-you gift from a recovered patient; get-well return gift

definitions.gloss: thank-you gift from a recovered patient; return gift after recovery from illness
definitions.explanation: A gift given by a person who has recovered from illness or injury to those who sent get-well gifts or visited during their recovery. Part of the Japanese {内祝|うちいわい} (reciprocal gift) custom, sent within one month of recovery.

examples.japanese: {快気内祝|かいきうちいわ}いを{贈|おく}った。
examples.english: I sent a thank-you gift after my recovery.

examples.japanese: {入院|にゅういん}のお{見舞|みま}いをいただいたので、{退院|たいいん}して{快気内祝|かいきうちいわ}いをお{送|おく}りした。
examples.english: Since I received get-well visits during my hospitalization, I sent thank-you gifts after being discharged.

examples.japanese: {快気内祝|かいきうちいわ}いには{日持|ひも}ちのする{消耗品|しょうもうひん}を{選|えら}ぶのが{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
examples.english: It is common to choose non-perishable consumables for get-well return gifts.

notes:
{快気|かいき} means recovery from illness; {内祝|うちいわい} is a reciprocal gift given to those who celebrated or supported you. The combination specifically refers to the return gift for get-well gestures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {快気内祝|かいきうちいわ}いを{贈|おく}る/{送|おく}る: to send a recovery thank-you gift
- {快気内祝|かいきうちいわ}いの{品|しな}: items for a get-well return gift
- {快気内祝|かいきうちいわ}いのし: noshi (gift wrapper label) for recovery gifts

Conventionally sent within one month of discharge or recovery. Common choices include packaged foods, towels, and other consumables.
